collocations: the main bottleneck 主要瓶颈
remove the bottleneck 消除瓶颈
become a bottleneck 成为瓶颈
bottleneck.etymology: The neck of a bottle is the narrow part that limits how fast liquid pours — the metaphor is the picture. 瓶颈就是瓶子最窄的那截：流速被它卡住，画面本身就是比喻。

example.en: Profiling shows the database is the bottleneck, not the API layer.
example.zh: 性能分析显示瓶颈在数据库，不在接口层。

collocations: cache hit / miss 缓存命中/未命中
invalidate the cache 让缓存失效
warm the cache 预热缓存
cache.etymology: French cacher, 'to hide'. A cache was a hidden store of supplies; in computing, a hidden store of data. 源自法语 cacher（藏）：本指藏物资的隐蔽仓库，计算机里就是藏数据的地方。

example.en: The bug was a stale cache — the page showed prices from yesterday.
example.zh: 问题出在缓存过期上：页面显示的还是昨天的价格。

collocations: concurrency control 并发控制
concurrent requests 并发请求
handle concurrency 处理并发
concurrency.etymology: Latin con- 'together' + currere 'to run': things running together. 注意它和 parallelism 的区别：concurrency 是结构（同时应对多件事），parallelism 是真并行执行。拉丁语 con-（一起）+ currere（跑）：一起跑。

example.en: Under high concurrency, two requests updated the same row and one overwrote the other.
example.zh: 高并发下两个请求同时改了同一行，一个把另一个覆盖了。

collocations: a deadlock occurs 发生死锁
avoid deadlocks 避免死锁
deadlock detection 死锁检测
deadlock.etymology: dead + lock: a lock so complete that nothing can move — first used for traffic and negotiations, then for threads. dead（死）+ lock（锁）：锁死到一动不能动，先用于交通和谈判僵局，后用于线程。

example.en: Thread A waits for B's lock while B waits for A's — a classic deadlock.
example.zh: 线程 A 等 B 的锁，B 又等 A 的锁，经典死锁。

collocations: a failed deployment 失败的发布
deploy to production 部署到生产环境
deployment pipeline 部署流水线
deployment.etymology: de- + Latin plicare 'to fold': to deploy was to unfold troops into formation. Unfolding software onto servers kept the word. de-（解开）+ 拉丁语 plicare（折叠）：本义是把军队“展开”成阵型，后来用来指把软件展开到服务器上。

example.en: Friday deployments are banned — nobody wants a weekend incident.
example.zh: 周五禁止发布，没人想周末处理故障。

collocations: deprecated in v2 在 v2 里被弃用
deprecate an API 弃用一个接口
will be deprecated 将被弃用
deprecate.etymology: Latin de- 'away' + precari 'to pray': originally 'to pray against' something, i.e. to wish it away — then 'to disapprove', now 'please stop using this'. 拉丁语 de-（离）+ precari（祈祷）：本义是“祈祷它别发生”，后来变成“弃用”。

example.en: This endpoint is deprecated; please migrate to /v2 before the end of the quarter.
example.zh: 这个接口已经弃用了，请在本季度结束前迁到 /v2。

collocations: a fallback plan 备选方案
fall back to 退回到…
as a fallback 作为兜底
fallback.etymology: fall + back: what you fall back on when the first plan fails. 字面就是“退回去靠的东西”：主方案不行时退守的备选。

example.en: If the primary region goes down, traffic falls back to the secondary automatically.
example.zh: 主区域挂掉时，流量会自动切到备用区域。

collocations: an idempotent operation 幂等操作
make it idempotent 把它改成幂等的
idempotent retries 幂等重试
idempotent.etymology: Latin idem 'the same' + potens 'powerful', a 19th-century math term: doing it twice has the same effect as once. 数学词：拉丁语 idem（相同）+ potens（有力量），做两遍和做一遍效果相同。

example.en: Make the payment endpoint idempotent, or a retry will charge the user twice.
example.zh: 支付接口必须做成幂等的，不然一次重试就会重复扣款。

collocations: low / high latency 低/高延迟
latency budget 延迟预算
tail latency (p99) 尾延迟
reduce latency 降低延迟
latency.etymology: Latin latens, 'hidden, lying dormant'. The delay is 'hidden' time before anything visibly happens. 源自拉丁语 latens（潜伏、隐藏）：延迟就是那段“什么都没发生”的隐藏时间。

example.en: Moving the cache closer to users cut our p99 latency from 800ms to 120ms.
example.zh: 把缓存挪到离用户更近的地方后，p99 延迟从 800 毫秒降到了 120 毫秒。

collocations: a data migration 数据迁移
run the migration 执行迁移
migration script 迁移脚本
migration.etymology: Latin migrare, 'to move from one place to another' — used for birds, people, and now databases. 拉丁语 migrare（从一地迁到另一地）：鸟、人、现在轮到数据库了。

example.en: Run the migration during the maintenance window, and keep a rollback ready.
example.zh: 在维护窗口里执行迁移，并准备好回滚。

note: 单词详解二期的人工内容：词源小注（etymology，中英对照）、常用搭配（collocations）、场景例句（example，职场语境）。人工撰写和维护，先覆盖高频技术词（当前 63 个），质量优先于数量。词源只写有把握的简明版，拿不准的宁可不写。

collocations: runtime overhead 运行时开销
adds overhead 增加开销
minimal overhead 开销极小
overhead.etymology: over + head: costs that sit 'above your head' whether you produce anything or not. over（在上）+ head（头）：悬在头顶、干不干活都要付的成本。

example.en: Encryption adds some overhead, but it is negligible at our scale.
example.zh: 加密会增加一点开销，但在我们的量级上可以忽略。

collocations: a message queue 消息队列
queue up 排队等待
process the queue 处理队列
queue.etymology: Latin cauda, 'tail', via French: a line of people looked like a tail — that is also why British 'queue' means a line of people. 源自拉丁语 cauda（尾巴），经法语而来：一排人看起来像条尾巴，英式英语里 queue 也就是“排队”。

example.en: Requests pile up in the queue whenever the workers fall behind.
example.zh: 只要处理端跟不上，请求就会在队列里堆起来。

collocations: a read replica 只读副本
replica lag 副本延迟
replication 复制（机制）
replica.etymology: Latin replicare, 'to fold back, repeat' (re- + plicare 'fold'). A replica is the original 'folded back' into a copy. 拉丁语 replicare（折回、重复，词根 plic 是“折叠”）：原件“折”出一份副本。

example.en: Reads go to the replica; writes always go to the primary.
example.zh: 读走副本，写永远走主库。

collocations: resilient to failure 对故障有韧性
build resilience 建立韧性/容错能力
a resilient design 韧性设计
resilient.etymology: Latin re- 'back' + salire 'to jump': literally 'jumping back'. A resilient system bounces back from failure. 拉丁语 re-（回）+ salire（跳）：字面是“弹回来”，所以指系统出故障后能自己恢复。

example.en: The service stayed resilient during the outage — it retried, degraded gracefully, and never lost data.
example.zh: 故障期间这个服务很抗造：重试、优雅降级，数据一条没丢。

collocations: retry the request 重试请求
retry with backoff 带退避地重试
automatic retries 自动重试
retry.etymology: re- 'again' + try. 'Try' itself comes from Old French trier, 'to sift, select' — you sift once more. re-（再次）+ try（尝试）；try 本身源自古法语 trier（筛选），再筛一遍。

example.en: Retry with exponential backoff, but cap it at three attempts.
example.zh: 用指数退避重试，但最多试三次。

collocations: a robust solution 稳健的方案
robust error handling 健壮的错误处理
robust enough for production 足够健壮、能上生产
robust.etymology: Latin robustus, from robur, 'oak tree'. Hard oak wood became the image of strength. 源自拉丁语 robur（橡树），橡木坚硬，所以引申为强壮、可靠。

example.en: The parser needs to be robust against malformed input from third-party feeds.
example.zh: 这个解析器必须扛得住第三方数据源的畸形输入。

collocations: roll back the deployment 回滚这次发布
a rollback plan 回滚方案
rollback to the previous version 回滚到上一版
rollback.etymology: roll + back: roll the system back like a log to where it was. roll（滚动）+ back（回）：像滚木头一样把系统滚回之前的状态。

example.en: Error rate spiked after the release, so we rolled back within five minutes.
example.zh: 发布后错误率飙升，我们五分钟内就回滚了。

collocations: highly scalable 高度可扩展的
scale horizontally / vertically 水平/垂直扩展
scalable architecture 可扩展架构
scalable.etymology: From Latin scala, 'ladder' — that is why old dictionaries list 'climbable' first. The computing sense comes from 'scale' as size: a system that can climb to a bigger size. 源自拉丁语 scala（梯子），所以老词典把“可攀登的”排第一；计算机义取 scale 的“规模”义：能爬到更大规模。

example.en: We need the design to be scalable before the marketing launch doubles our traffic.
example.zh: 市场推广会让流量翻倍，设计必须先做到可扩展。

collocations: shard by user id 按用户 id 分片
a shard key 分片键
sharding strategy 分片策略
shard.etymology: Old English sceard, 'a fragment, a broken piece' (of pottery). Sharding breaks one big database into pieces. 古英语 sceard（碎片、破陶片）：分片就是把一个大库打成碎片分开放。

example.en: We shard by tenant id so one noisy tenant cannot slow down the others.
example.zh: 我们按租户 id 分片，这样一个闹腾的租户拖不慢其他人。

collocations: take a snapshot 做一个快照
a snapshot of the database 数据库快照
snapshot testing 快照测试
snapshot.etymology: snap + shot: a quick hunter's shot, then a quick photo — a frozen picture of one moment. snap（快速）+ shot（一击）：本是猎人的速射，后指快照：某一瞬间的定格。

example.en: Take a snapshot of the volume before running the migration.
example.zh: 跑迁移之前，先给这个卷做个快照。

collocations: a stateless service 无状态服务
stateless by design 设计上无状态
keep it stateless 保持无状态
stateless.etymology: state from Latin status, 'standing, condition', plus -less 'without'. 无状态 = 不记着上一次请求发生过什么。state 源自拉丁语 status（状态），加 -less（无）。

example.en: If the service is stateless, we can add instances behind the load balancer freely.
example.zh: 只要服务是无状态的，我们就能在负载均衡后面随意加实例。

collocations: throttle requests 限制请求速率
get throttled 被限流
throttling policy 限流策略
throttle.etymology: From 'throat': to throttle was to choke. Choking the flow of a pipe became limiting any flow. 来自 throat（喉咙），本义是掐脖子；掐住管道的流量，就成了“限流”。

example.en: The API throttles us at 100 requests per minute, so we added a queue.
example.zh: 接口把我们限在每分钟 100 次请求，所以我们加了个队列。

collocations: high throughput 高吞吐
throughput of 10k requests per second 每秒一万请求的吞吐量
max out throughput 打满吞吐
throughput.etymology: A plain compound: through + put — how much a factory could put through in a day, later borrowed by computing. 直白的复合词：through（穿过）+ put（放），原指工厂一天能“过”多少货，后来被计算机借用。

example.en: Batching the writes tripled throughput without adding any servers.
example.zh: 把写入改成批量后，没加一台服务器，吞吐量涨到了三倍。

collocations: a 30-second timeout 30 秒超时
time out 超时（动词）
set a timeout 设置超时
timeout.etymology: time + out: the time runs out. Originally a sports pause; in computing, a deadline that cancels the wait. time（时间）+ out（用完）：时间耗尽。原指体育暂停，后指等待的截止线。

example.en: The request timed out because the downstream service never responded.
example.zh: 下游服务一直没响应，这个请求就超时了。

collocations: asynchronous calls 异步调用
async / await 异步写法
handle it asynchronously 异步处理
asynchronous.etymology: Greek a- 'not' + syn- 'together' + chronos 'time': not at the same time. 三个希腊部件：a-（不）+ syn-（一起）+ chronos（时间），字面“不在同一时间”。

example.en: Make the upload asynchronous so the user is not blocked waiting for it.
example.zh: 把上传做成异步的，这样用户不用干等着。

collocations: user authentication 用户认证
authentication failed 认证失败
two-factor authentication 双因素认证
authentication.etymology: Greek authentikos, 'genuine', from authentes, 'someone acting on their own authority'. Proving you are genuinely you. 希腊语 authentikos（真实的），源头是“有权自己做主的人”：证明你真是你。

example.en: Authentication is handled by the gateway; the services behind it just trust the token.
example.zh: 认证由网关统一处理，后面的服务信任令牌就行。

collocations: high availability 高可用
availability zone 可用区
99.9% availability 99.9% 可用性
availability.etymology: From Latin valere, 'to be strong, to be worth' (via avail). A system that is 'worth something' when you need it. 源自拉丁语 valere（强壮、有价值）：你需要时它顶用，就是可用。

example.en: We run in two availability zones so one can fail without downtime.
example.zh: 我们在两个可用区部署，一个挂了也不会停服。

collocations: bandwidth limits 带宽限制
consume bandwidth 占用带宽
save bandwidth 省带宽
bandwidth.etymology: band (a range of frequencies) + width: how wide the pipe is. band（频带）+ width（宽度）：管道有多宽。

example.en: Video calls eat most of the office bandwidth in the morning.
example.zh: 视频会议吃掉了办公室早上的大部分带宽。

collocations: a circular buffer 环形缓冲
buffer the stream 缓冲流数据
buffer overflow 缓冲区溢出
buffer.etymology: Linked to 'buff', a dull thud: a buffer is the soft layer that absorbs the impact between two harder things. 与 buff（沉闷的撞击声）有关：缓冲就是夹在两个硬东西之间吃掉冲击的那层。

example.en: The player buffers a few seconds ahead so the video never stutters.
example.zh: 播放器会提前缓冲几秒，视频就不会卡了。

collocations: a callback function 回调函数
register a callback 注册回调
on complete callback 完成回调
callback.etymology: call + back: like returning a phone call. You hand over your number (the function) and get called back when ready. call（打电话）+ back（回）：像回拨电话，你把“号码”（函数）留下，有结果了再打回来。

example.en: Pass a callback and it will fire once the file is fully written.
example.zh: 传入一个回调，文件写完时它就会被调用。

collocations: a Kubernetes cluster K8s 集群
cluster nodes 集群节点
run in a cluster 跑在集群里
cluster.etymology: Old English clyster, 'a bunch' (like a bunch of grapes): many individual units acting as one bunch. 古英语 clyster（一串，如葡萄串）：许多个体抱成一团对外像一个整体。

example.en: The cluster scales from three nodes to ten during peak hours.
example.zh: 这个集群在高峰期会从 3 个节点扩到 10 个。

collocations: the compiler warns 编译器警告
compile-time errors 编译期错误
a just-in-time compiler 即时编译器
compiler.etymology: Latin compilare, 'to gather together, pile up'. A compiler gathers your code and piles it into machine code. 拉丁语 compilare（汇集、堆积）：编译器把代码收集起来，“编”成机器码。

example.en: The compiler caught the type error before the code ever ran.
example.zh: 代码还没跑，编译器就先把这个类型错误抓出来了。

collocations: configuration file 配置文件
environment-specific configuration 环境相关配置
misconfiguration 配置错误
configuration.etymology: con- 'together' + Latin figura 'shape': how the parts are shaped together. con-（一起）+ 拉丁语 figura（形状）：各部件拼在一起的形状。

example.en: Most outages I have seen were configuration mistakes, not code bugs.
example.zh: 我见过的故障多数是配置错误，不是代码 bug。

collocations: strong consistency 强一致性
eventual consistency 最终一致性
consistency guarantees 一致性保证
consistency.etymology: Latin consistere, 'to stand firm' (con- + sistere 'stand'). Data that 'stands firm' — the same from every angle. 拉丁语 consistere（站稳）：从哪个角度看都立得住、不自相矛盾。

example.en: For balances we need strong consistency; for likes, eventual is fine.
example.zh: 余额需要强一致，点赞数最终一致就够了。

collocations: a Docker container Docker 容器
container image 容器镜像
run in containers 跑在容器里
container.etymology: contain, from Latin con- + tenere 'to hold': that which holds things together. Shipping containers standardized the box; software borrowed both. contain 源自拉丁语 con- + tenere（持有）：把东西装在一起的盒子，航运集装箱和软件容器用的是同一个比喻。

example.en: The app ships as a container, so it runs the same on my laptop and in production.
example.zh: 应用打成容器交付，在我电脑上和生产环境跑起来一模一样。

collocations: a dependency on 对…的依赖
dependency injection 依赖注入
upgrade dependencies 升级依赖
dependency.etymology: de- 'down' + Latin pendere 'to hang': hanging down from something else, relying on it to hold you. de-（向下）+ 拉丁语 pendere（悬挂）：挂在别的东西上，靠它撑着。pend 和 pending（悬而未决）同源。

example.en: Keep the dependency list short — every library is something you have to maintain.
example.zh: 依赖清单要短，每个库都是你要维护的东西。

collocations: deterministic behavior 确定性行为
a deterministic test 结果确定的测试
non-deterministic bugs 非确定性 bug
deterministic.etymology: de- + Latin terminus 'a boundary, an end': the outcome is fenced in in advance. de- + 拉丁语 terminus（界限、终点）：结果提前被边界圈定，没有意外。

example.en: Sort the output so the test is deterministic and stops flaking.
example.zh: 把输出排一下序，这个测试就结果确定、不再时好时坏了。

collocations: end-to-end encryption 端到端加密
encrypt at rest 静态加密
encryption keys 加密密钥
encryption.etymology: Greek kryptos, 'hidden' — the root of 'crypt'. To encrypt is to put something into the crypt, hidden. 希腊语 kryptos（隐藏的），也是 crypt（地窖）的源头：加密就是把东西藏进地窖。

example.en: All traffic is encrypted in transit, and the disks are encrypted at rest.
example.zh: 所有传输都加密，磁盘上的数据也是静态加密的。

collocations: throw an exception 抛出异常
exception handling 异常处理
an unhandled exception 未处理的异常
exception.etymology: Latin ex- 'out' + capere 'to take': the case that is 'taken out' of the normal flow. 拉丁语 ex-（出）+ capere（拿）：从正常流程里被“拿出来”的那个情况。

example.en: Do not catch the exception just to log it and pretend nothing happened.
example.zh: 别抓住异常只打个日志就假装什么都没发生。

collocations: a web framework Web 框架
framework conventions 框架的约定
within the framework 在框架之内
framework.etymology: frame + work: the skeleton you build inside of, as opposed to a library you call. frame（骨架）+ work：框架是你住进去的骨架，库是你调用的工具，区别就在这。

example.en: The framework handles routing and auth; we only write the business logic.
example.zh: 框架负责路由和认证，我们只写业务逻辑。

collocations: a generic type 泛型类型
generic code 通用代码
generics in Java / TypeScript Java/TS 里的泛型
generic.etymology: Latin genus, 'a kind, a class' (same root as 'general' and 'generate'). Code written for a whole class of types. 拉丁语 genus（种类、类别），和 general、generate 同源：为一整类类型写的代码就是泛型。

example.en: Write it as a generic function and it works for any record type.
example.zh: 把它写成泛型函数，任何记录类型都能用。

collocations: the heap 堆（内存）
a heap allocation 堆上分配
min-heap / max-heap 最小堆/最大堆
heap.etymology: Old English heap, 'a pile'. Both the memory region and the tree data structure borrow the image of things piled up. 古英语 heap（一堆）：内存的堆和树结构的堆，借的都是“东西堆在一起”的象。

example.en: Large objects go on the heap; the stack only holds small, short-lived values.
example.zh: 大对象放在堆上，栈只放小的、短命的值。

collocations: immutable data 不可变数据
an immutable object 不可变对象
treat it as immutable 把它当不可变的
immutable.etymology: in- 'not' + Latin mutare 'to change' — the root mut- also gives 'mutate' and 'mutation'. in-（不）+ 拉丁语 mutare（改变）：mut- 这个词根也给了 mutate（突变）。

example.en: Keep the state immutable; return a new object instead of editing the old one.
example.zh: 状态保持不可变，要改就返回一个新对象，别动旧的。

collocations: an instance of 的一个实例
spin up an instance 拉起一个实例
instance type 实例规格
instance.etymology: Latin instantia, 'presence', from in- + stare 'to stand': something standing right there — one concrete case. 拉丁语 instantia（在场），来自“站着”：一个具体地站在你面前的例子。

example.en: Each tenant gets its own instance of the worker, isolated from the rest.
example.zh: 每个租户有自己独立的 worker 实例，和其他人隔开。

collocations: a clean interface 干净的接口
the API interface 接口（API）
implement an interface 实现一个接口
interface.etymology: inter- 'between' + face: the surface where two things meet. inter-（之间）+ face（面）：两个东西相接的那个面。

example.en: Hide the database behind an interface and swapping it later gets easy.
example.zh: 把数据库藏在一个接口后面，以后换库就容易了。

collocations: the Linux kernel Linux 内核
kernel panic 内核崩溃
a kernel update 内核升级
kernel.etymology: Old English cyrnel, 'a small seed or grain' (a little corn): the seed at the centre of the plant. 古英语 cyrnel（小种子）：植物最中央的那颗仁，就是内核。

example.en: The bug turned out to be in a kernel driver, not in our code.
example.zh: 查到最后，bug 在一个内核驱动里，不在我们代码里。

collocations: monitor the service 监控这个服务
monitoring dashboard 监控大盘
set up monitoring 把监控建起来
monitor.etymology: Latin monere, 'to warn, to advise'. A monitor is the thing that warns you. 拉丁语 monere（警告、劝告）：监控的本职就是提前警告你。

example.en: Monitor the error rate, not just CPU — users feel errors, not load.
example.zh: 要监控错误率，不只是 CPU，用户感受到的是错误，不是负载。

collocations: observability tooling 可观测性工具
improve observability 提升可观测性
logs, metrics, traces 日志、指标、链路
observability.etymology: From 'observe' (Latin ob- + servare, 'to watch over'), a term borrowed from control theory: judging the inside of a system from its outputs. 源自“观察”（拉丁语 servare 是守护、注视），是控制论的词：从外部输出推断系统内部状态。

example.en: Without observability, debugging production is just guessing with logs open.
example.zh: 没有可观测性，查生产问题就是开着日志瞎猜。

collocations: a CI pipeline CI 流水线
the build pipeline 构建流水线
pipeline stages 流水线阶段
pipeline.etymology: pipe + line: a line of pipes carrying oil or water; then, work flowing stage by stage. pipe（管子）+ line（线）：先是输油输水的管道，后指工作一段段流过去。

example.en: The pipeline runs tests on every push and blocks the merge if they fail.
example.zh: 每次推送流水线都会跑测试，失败就挡住合并。

collocations: the HTTP protocol HTTP 协议
follow the protocol 遵循协议
a communication protocol 通信协议
protocol.etymology: Greek protokollon: proto- 'first' + kolla 'glue' — the first sheet glued onto a manuscript, listing its rules. A protocol is still 'the rules sheet'. 希腊语 protokollon：proto-（第一）+ kolla（胶），原指粘在手稿最前面的那页规范，协议至今仍是那张“规则页”。

example.en: Both sides must speak the same protocol version or the handshake fails.
example.zh: 两边必须用同一个协议版本，不然握手就失败。

collocations: recursive function 递归函数
infinite recursion 无限递归
base case 基线情况（递归终止条件）
recursion.etymology: Latin re- 'back' + currere 'to run': running back into itself. 拉丁语 re-（回）+ currere（跑）：跑回自己身上，和 current、concurrency 同根。

example.en: Every recursion needs a base case, or it runs until the stack blows up.
example.zh: 每个递归都要有终止条件，不然会跑到爆栈。

collocations: a git repository Git 仓库
clone the repository 克隆仓库
the repo 仓库（口头简称）
repository.etymology: Latin re- + ponere 'to put': a place where things are put away for keeping. 拉丁语 re- + ponere（放）：把东西收回去存放的地方。pon- 和 position 同根。

example.en: Clone the repository and run the setup script; it takes two minutes.
example.zh: 把仓库克隆下来跑一下初始化脚本，两分钟搞定。

collocations: at runtime 在运行时
runtime errors 运行时错误
a JavaScript runtime JS 运行时
runtime.etymology: A plain compound, run + time: the period when the program runs, and by extension the environment that runs it. 直白复合词 run + time：程序跑着的那段时间，后来也指让它跑起来的那套环境。

example.en: This check happens at runtime, so the compiler will not save you.
example.zh: 这个检查发生在运行时，编译器帮不了你。

collocations: the database schema 数据库结构
a JSON schema JSON 模式
schema changes 结构变更
schema.etymology: Greek skhema, 'form, shape, a plan'. A schema is the shape your data must fit. 希腊语 skhema（形状、图式）：数据必须长成的那个形状，就是 schema。

example.en: Changing the schema is easy; migrating the old data is the hard part.
example.zh: 改结构容易，难的是迁移旧数据。

collocations: a user session 用户会话
session expires 会话过期
log in session 登录会话
session.etymology: Latin sessio, 'a sitting', from sedere 'to sit': one sitting together — a meeting, a class, a login. 拉丁语 sessio（一次坐着），来自 sedere（坐）：坐下来开的一次会、上的一堂课、登的一次录。

example.en: The session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity, so users have to log in again.
example.zh: 会话闲置 30 分钟就过期，用户得重新登录。

collocations: a WebSocket connection WebSocket 连接
open a socket 打开一个套接字
socket timeout 套接字超时
socket.etymology: From an Old French word for a small ploughshare — something shaped to plug into. It became any hollow part you plug something into, then the endpoint of a network connection. 源自古法语里指小犁头的词，后来指一切“插进去的套”，再引申为网络连接的端点。

example.en: The socket closed unexpectedly, so the client reconnects with backoff.
example.zh: 套接字意外断了，客户端就带退避地重连。

collocations: the call stack 调用栈
stack overflow 栈溢出
a full-stack developer 全栈开发者
stack.etymology: Old Norse stakkr, 'a haystack': a pile where you can only take from the top. 古诺斯语 stakkr（干草堆）：只能从顶上取的一摞东西。stack overflow 的社区名字也来自这个“溢出”。

example.en: Read the stack trace from the top — the first frame is where it actually broke.
example.zh: 从栈轨迹的最上面开始看，第一帧才是真正出错的地方。

collocations: an email template 邮件模板
template engine 模板引擎
use a template 用模板
template.etymology: Related to the 'templet', a bar in a loom that held cloth to the right width — a pattern to match. 与织布机上把布撑到固定宽度的样板杆有关：一个供比照的模子。

example.en: Start from the service template instead of wiring everything by hand.
example.zh: 从服务模板起步，别什么都手动搭。

collocations: a background thread 后台线程
thread-safe 线程安全的
the main thread 主线程
thread.etymology: Old English thraed, from a verb meaning 'to twist': a twisted fibre. A thread of execution runs through the program like a thread through cloth. 古英语 thraed，源头是“拧”：拧成的一根线。执行线程像线一样穿过程序，正如线穿过布。

example.en: Never block the main thread with network calls; move them to a background thread.
example.zh: 绝不能用网络调用阻塞主线程，把它们挪到后台线程去。

collocations: an alert threshold 告警阈值
cross the threshold 越过阈值
set a threshold 设一个阈值
threshold.etymology: Old English for the wooden sill at a doorway: the strip you step over to enter. 古英语里就是门口那根木头门槛：迈过去就进了另一个状态。

example.en: Alert only when the error rate crosses the threshold for five straight minutes.
example.zh: 错误率连续五分钟都越过阈值时才告警。

collocations: an access token 访问令牌
token expires 令牌过期
refresh the token 刷新令牌
token.etymology: Old English tacen, 'a sign' (the source of modern 'token' and German Zeichen). A small sign that stands for a bigger right. 古英语 tacen（记号）：一个小记号，代表一份更大的权利。

example.en: Never log the token — anyone who reads the logs owns the account.
example.zh: 绝不能把令牌打进日志，谁看到日志谁就拿到了账号。

collocations: a variable name 变量名
declare a variable 声明变量
global variable 全局变量
variable.etymology: Latin variare, 'to vary, to change': the quantity that is allowed to change — the opposite of a constant. 拉丁语 variare（变化）：可以变的量，和 constant（常量）正好相对。

example.en: Name the variable after what it holds, not after its type.
example.zh: 变量名按它装的东西起，别按类型起。

collocations: a virtual machine 虚拟机
virtual memory 虚拟内存
virtual DOM 虚拟 DOM
virtual.etymology: Latin virtus, 'power, excellence': virtual meant 'effective in power, if not in form'. A virtual machine has the power of a machine without being one. 拉丁语 virtus（力量）：virtual 的原义是“效力上是、形式上不是”，虚拟机有机器的效力、却不是机器。

example.en: The virtual DOM diff is cheap; the real DOM write is the expensive part.
example.zh: 虚拟 DOM 的比对很便宜，贵的是真正写 DOM 那一步。
